Four numbers. One number that stings.

Plug in your monthly leads, close rate, average job value, and current response time.

The calculator hands back your revenue per lead, what slow follow-up costs you every month, and what a 10% improvement in each system is worth over a year.

Most owners expect a small number. They don't get one.

Free. No signup. No card. Four inputs, real math, straight to your numbers.
